messages.content: Predict a participant’s actual response in an online experiment. There is one simultaneous game round with another unfamiliar remote player. Each independently chooses X or Y; neither chooses the other’s action. There is no opportunity to revise the final game choice. X is the competitive option and Y the cooperative option. Each payoff pair below is (own payoff, other player’s payoff), with the first letter denoting own choice and the second the other’s choice. Payoffs are hypothetical points: XX=(20,20), XY=(100,0), YX=(0,100), YY=(60,60). No material game incentive depends on these points; participation gives course credit. Before the game, the participant rated ten own values from -1 (opposed to my values), 0 (not important), 3 (important), 6 (very important) to 7 (of supreme importance); intermediate whole-number ratings were available. The participant was told they would play with another person and that their highly rated value items would be sent to that partner. They then read the items said to be the partner’s highest-rated values. No exact partner rating numbers were supplied in the available materials. Output only X or Y. Predict the human choice, not an optimal strategy.

Participant background: age 18 years; gender female. These stable descriptors were collected after the game.
Other stable self-reports: first language Hebrew; attention/concentration disorder no; other learning disorder no.
Earlier own value ratings on the -1 to 7 scale (these precede the game):
- It is important to me to care for the welfare of people I am in contact with. I strive to be responsible, loyal, honest and forgiving. Rating: 7.
- It is important to me to be independent in thought and behaviour and open to change and innovation. I strive to live freely and show curiosity and creativity. Rating: 6.
- It is important to me to understand and accept others while caring for the welfare of all people and equality. I strive to be intellectually and emotionally open to my surroundings and care for environmental quality. Rating: 5.
- It is important to me to live safely in a stable and orderly place. I strive to care for my family’s safety and health. Rating: 5.
- It is important to me to obey social norms or expectations and avoid actions that might annoy others. Being polite and self-disciplined is important to me. I strive to respect parents and older people. Rating: 5.
- It is important to me to excel, gain general recognition of my abilities and succeed according to social standards. Rating: 5.
- It is important to me to enjoy myself and obtain sensory gratification for myself, enjoy life and pamper myself. Rating: 3.
- It is important to me to experience constant changes, excitement and challenges. I strive to be daring and live a varied and exciting life. Rating: 3.
- It is important to me to preserve the status quo and stick to what is familiar. I strive to be humble and moderate and respect institutions, traditions and religion. Rating: 3.
- It is important to me to attain high status and prestige and a position of influence over other people. I strive to be rich and control resources. Rating: 1.
Items presented as particularly high for the partner among their own values:
Value: It is important to me to excel, gain general recognition of my abilities and succeed according to social standards.
Value: It is important to me to attain high status and prestige and a position of influence over other people. I strive to be rich and control resources.
Make the one final simultaneous choice now. The other player’s current choice is not available. No previous game round exists in this interaction.
